headline: Daily research brief — Saturday, October 3

items.title: Friday closed higher across the board, tech leading
items.detail: SPY finished Friday at 769.64 (+0.74%), QQQ at 749.58 (+1.02%) leading the major indices, DIA at 511.10 (+0.49%) and IWM at 281.52 (+0.90%). Breadth was healthy — small caps participating alongside large caps, not a narrow rally. Markets are closed Saturday; these are Friday's closing levels.

items.title: SPY strength pushes the workbench seed further out of the money
items.detail: With SPY closing at 769.64, the workbench reference seed (Oct-30 749 put, bid 6.45 / ask 6.52 as of Oct 1) sits roughly 20 points out of the money. Premium sellers should note the underlying has moved favorably for existing short-put exposure, but new put sales at the 749 strike now collect less premium per unit of risk than when the seed was captured.
